_comment: OG card manifest. Each entry produces <slug>.svg + <slug>.png in brand/og/. kind selects the template (page|article|research|tool). accent keys into PALETTE in scripts/build-og-cards.mjs. focus is an optional module { type: 'type'|'funnel'|'stat'|'score-ring'|'list'|'quote', ...data }. locale is for hreflang pairing; ES cards use slug '-es' suffix.

cards.dek: Tokens, scripts, translation pipeline, search, research. The moving parts, named.
